messages:
Rajesh Kumar: prod alert — continuous-batcher throughput down ~32% in us-west1 on model/opt-6 after staged rollout. Observed token/s drop and longer queueing delays.
Alisa V: saw same on dashboard, p50 latency +180ms, p95 +1.2s, token/sec from ~45k -> ~31k :alarm:
Sam Walker: timeline? which commits rolled where? deploy-bot shows staged rollout at 10:12 UTC.
Rajesh Kumar: rollout started 2026-03-17T10:12Z canary->staged. PR #4821 changed kernel-hinting: fallback order now prefers memcopy-optimized kernel for short sequences (internal change).
Mariya Gomez: interesting — KV cache hit rate dropped from 78% -> 61% in the same window on traces. Could be key packing/order mismatch or timing.
Alisa V: quick flamegraph snapshot from pprof (staging run): ```
cpu: 12.3s total
  4.8s runtime/kernel_select
  3.1s scheduler/coalesce
  2.3s kvcache/lookup
```
Sam Walker: can we reproduce in staging with loadgen? rajesh can you run: `./tools/loadgen --profile ctb --tokens 100k --model opt-6 --concurrency 50` against staged ring?
Rajesh Kumar: starting now. Early logs show batch sizes collapsing to 1-2 more frequently. Snippet: ```
BATCH_STAT: avg_size=1.9, median=1, drain_wait_ms=12, token_rate=32k
```
Mariya Gomez: if batches shrink, kv cache hit locality will drop (less prefix sharing). Also the memcopy-preferring kernel does extra memcpy latency on the hot path which interferes with coalescing.
Alisa V: checked PR diff — there is a change to KV key packing in the same commit (reorder for alignment). That could explain cache misses.
Sam Walker: plan: reproduce -> bisect -> revert if bisect points to PR4821. Rajesh, can you run a revert in staging or cut a quick revert PR and pause rollout?
Rajesh Kumar: preparing revert PR for kernel-hinting + kv packing order. Meanwhile requesting rollout hold. @deploy-bot please pause staged rollout.
deploy-bot: rollout paused for ring staged at 2026-03-17T10:35Z by Rajesh Kumar
Mariya Gomez: short-term mitigation: increase batching window to force aggregation (sched.batch_window_ms 20 -> 28). That should smooth avg batch size until we revert.
Sam Walker: applying temp config bump on staged and will re-run loadgen. Command: `rbctl set config sched.batch_window_ms=28 --ring staged`
Alisa V: after bump and re-run, tokens/sec recovered to ~43k, p95 improved from 1.2s -> 420ms. Not back to original but much better.
Rajesh Kumar: bisect results: when we revert kernel-hinting portion alone, perf recovers; when we revert kv packing reorder alone, KV hit rate returns. Both changes introduced in same PR accidentally. Revert PR #4830 prepared.
Mariya Gomez: followups: add unit tests that prevent KV packing order regressions (round-trip packing/unpacking hash invariant), and add a perf regression test exercising CTB + kvcache on PRs that touch kernel selection or kv packing.
Sam Walker: I'll add an e2e perf CI job (ctb-smoke) that runs on kernel-related PRs and fails the merge if tokens/sec drops >5% from baseline.
Rajesh Kumar: merging revert once CI passes, holding rollout. After merge I'll monitor for 60 minutes and then schedule a controlled re-roll with the fixes.
Alisa V: :thumbsup:
Sam Walker: tagging eng-runtime, eng-releases, and eng-ml for visibility.
Rajesh Kumar: thanks team — good catch.
end
